reasoning: Both sets are detailed, multi-package plans with frozen contracts, synthetic-first walking skeletons and per-task context packets, and both miss parts of the user's Stage 1 brief: both use SSE instead of the requested WebSocket, and both use the Nasdaq Data Link client instead of api.sharadar.com. Set A's quant design is stronger and more complete. It has one shared walk-forward schedule with a purge gap and a lockbox, and a hypothesis ledger in which every comparison runs through null-hypothesis-testing. The PCA factor count is fitted per window, Marchenko–Pastur denoising is fitted on each window, and backtest conventions are pinned (AD-23). Stage 4 is complete: neural forecasters, forecast portfolios, PPO agents with a configuration budget, a rented GPU with verified teardown, and a final verdict. M1 also has 27 golden known-answer cases with oracles in its packets. Set A's real defects: it has no Yahoo/yahooquery cross-check and does not use the user's 10 delisted names. CONSTRAINTS.md is missing even though every packet and AGENTS.md tell the builder to read it. references.md lists stages (S2, S3/S4) rather than milestones, and roadmap M4–M8 carry no References lines. Set B covers the cross-check and the 10-name reference check. It ships CONSTRAINTS.md, puts references on the milestones they serve, and splits each later stage into a synthetic skeleton followed by a real-data milestone. However, it drops PPO agents and the rented GPU from Stage 4 ('a separate, later idea'; 'no cloud compute ... as the brief requires', which the brief never says). It uses yfinance rather than yahooquery, and keeps AD-03 Accepted even though its own probe shows yfinance failing. Its S1 data package has no golden cases at all, its three interface tasks run in parallel even though they import each other's types, and the mount_reads boundary leaves out the Catalog that its messages need. On balance Set A is the sounder and more complete plan, but only narrowly, because of its own Stage 1 gaps and the missing CONSTRAINTS.md.
